nodes.label: Kopeck-to-Hryvnia Prices
nodes.rationale: Prices are transmitted in kopecks (1 UAH = 100); dividing by 100 twice is a classic bug, so the client exposes price_uah.

nodes.label: Truncated Variants in products-filtered
nodes.rationale: products-filtered embeds only one variant; full list requires the separate product-variants endpoint.

nodes.label: Client CI Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Shared CI shape across all three clients: uv + ruff lint/format + mypy + pytest with coverage, then build sdist/wheel.

nodes.label: Stores Configuration
nodes.rationale: Categories mirror each site's taxonomy; 'code' is the DB category id while 'url'/'filters' are the client-library source parameters. Per-store formats differ: flagman url=category id + filters string, ibisgear url=taxon code, bereg url=listing page URL.

nodes.label: Canonical Column Dictionary
nodes.rationale: Variant A shared typing: common types are a documented structural contract (no separate 4th repo); CANONICAL_FIELDS is the single source of truth for Excel headers, SQLite columns and UI filters.

nodes.label: Extractors
nodes.rationale: Thin adapters mapping each client model to LureRecord, keeping store-specific parsing out of the shared canonical layer.

nodes.label: LureRecord
nodes.rationale: Pydantic model of all canonical columns plus service fields store/category; validator clears old_price<=price, computes discount_pct when unset, and normalizes enum fields.

nodes.label: price_history
nodes.rationale: Snapshot row on every UPSERT, accumulating a per-product price history.

nodes.label: SQLite Schema
nodes.rationale: products has hybrid typed columns plus extra_json, allowing weight/length/price filtering via SQL while preserving full source payload.

nodes.label: Lures Aggregator
nodes.rationale: Aggregates three independent store-scraper client libraries into one canonical format, stores to SQLite (data/lures.db), displays via Streamlit and exports to Excel.

nodes.label: ibis-gear Workflow
nodes.rationale: Recorded process used to build clients/ibisgear-client so the site integration can be re-researched if it changes.

nodes.label: itemsPerPage 403 Gotcha
nodes.rationale: Sending itemsPerPage returns HTTP 403, so pagination defaults to 20 products / 30 variants per page and only 'page' may be used.
